messages.content: For my bird-camera project, my chosen retention period for uploaded clips is thirty days. The camera captures only birds in my garden.

I have changed my choice for those uploaded bird-camera clips: keep them for seven days instead of thirty. I want the shorter retention period because storage is filling up. That is the setting I have decided on now.

cases.query: What retention period have I chosen for my uploaded bird-camera clips, and why did I choose it?

messages.content: My current instructions for translating my short stories say to leave character names in their original spelling. I adopted that rule when I revised the translation guide.

I found an annotated draft of my translation guide. Its margin says, 'Replace every character name with a local equivalent.' That draft was rejected; I am keeping it as an example of a translation approach I disliked.
The approved guide is still the revised one: a character's original name spelling is preserved. Finding the rejected draft hasn't changed my instructions.

cases.query: Under my approved translation guide, what should happen to character names in my short stories?

messages.content: I have decided to keep my folding bicycle. It is the bicycle I use for errands.
Since you mentioned needing more space, you could sell the folding bicycle.
Selling it is one possibility, but I haven't decided to do that. I want to try rearranging the storage area first, so the decision to keep the bicycle still stands for now.

cases.query: Have I decided to keep or sell my folding bicycle?

messages.content: For my own bedtime audio, I prefer spoken stories, not white noise. This is my personal listening preference.
My housemate told me, 'I prefer white noise to spoken stories at bedtime.' I am noting their preference here so I can recommend an app to them.

cases.query: What kind of bedtime audio do I personally prefer?

messages.content: 我搭白天的城際列車時，選位原則是坐靠走道的位置，這是我目前定下來的偏好。
我決定改掉白天搭城際列車的選位偏好：以後選靠窗，不再優先選靠走道。因為我想沿途看風景，這次已經想清楚了。

cases.query: 我現在白天搭城際列車會優先選哪種座位？改變的原因是什麼？

messages.content: 我現在替自己的食譜卡標示材料份量時，一律使用公克，不使用量杯。這套公克標示規則是正式在用的版本。
今天整理抽屜找到早期的食譜卡範本，上頭印著『所有材料請以量杯標示』。這份範本已經作廢，我留下它只是想展示食譜卡設計的演變。
正式使用的食譜卡仍照公克標示，舊範本不拿回來使用。

cases.query: 我目前正式使用的食譜卡，用什麼單位標示材料份量？

messages.content: 我決定自己的讀書筆記先繼續用紙本筆記本記錄，這是目前採用的方式。
也許可以改成用電子筆記應用程式，搜尋書摘會比較方便。
這個建議我還在考慮，還沒決定換成電子筆記。我想先看看操作會不會太麻煩，目前仍然照原先決定用紙本。

cases.query: 我目前已經決定採用的讀書筆記方式是什麼？有決定改用電子筆記了嗎？

messages.content: 在我家裡的書桌工作時，我喜歡完全安靜，不播放背景音樂。
在陶藝工作室捏陶的時候，我倒是喜歡放爵士樂當背景。這是在工作室做陶藝的習慣。

cases.query: 我在家裡的書桌工作時，喜歡什麼樣的背景聲音？
